unresolved_limits.statement: The current files cannot prove that no other response was overwritten before a checksum-bearing reference to it was saved. There was no pre-existing immutable allocation ledger against which to compare the 68 surviving files.

Historical attempts embed provider responses in mutable-looking sample paths and have no separate immutable provider-response file. The patched runner applies the stronger boundary only to future calls.

behavior: Future completed attempts allocate max sample index across every system/request revision in the case, then add one.
Creation uses exclusive file mode and retries allocation after a race; existing record bytes are never replaced.
Indices above 999 remain discoverable and continue numerically.
Every future provider response is first written once to a UUID-keyed immutable provider-response record before parsing.
Transport retry snapshots use UUID-keyed, per-transport-attempt paths instead of overwriting sample_001.pending.json.
Reuse and rebuild inspect only the newest attempt for the exact request; a newer failure or rejection cannot expose an older success as current.
